full.title: Separate services

mono-repo.help: The AAS environment serves the repositories; registries and discovery run as separate services. Enables export and upload.

identifiable.help: Only an AAS repository; submodels are read through the shells that reference them.

connections.title: Connections
connections.help: Services that content of this infrastructure refers to but that are not AAS services, such as a time series database, and HTTP services that apps call. Studio keeps their credentials and uses them only for content read from this infrastructure and for the apps bound to them.
connections.keyHint: Identifies the connection within this infrastructure.
connections.keyInvalid: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.

typeHints.influxdb2: Time series of the LinkedSegments of Time Series Data submodels (Flux).
typeHints.http: Apps call the operations they declare in their manifest, where you bind them below. Studio sends the requests with these credentials.

connections.urlHint: How Studio reaches the service, e.g. in its container network.
connections.aliasesHint: Other addresses under which submodels name the service. Studio never contacts them.
connections.organizationHint: Replaces the organization of the endpoints in submodels. Leave empty to use theirs.
connections.appsHint: App connections that may call this service. Each lists the operations it declares; the app reaches nothing else.
connections.appNotInstalled: The app is not installed, or declares no such connection. Its operations are shown once it is installed.
connections.appInvalid: Enter an app ID such as org.example.app.

schemeHints.token: Studio sends "Authorization: Token" with the secret, as InfluxDB expects.
schemeHints.bearer: Studio sends "Authorization: Bearer" with the secret.
schemeHints.header: Studio sends the secret in a header of your choice.
schemeHints.oauth2ClientCredentials: Studio gets a token from the issuer with these client credentials.
schemeHints.delegatedUser: Studio exchanges the user's token for one issued to the service (RFC 8693).

connections.audienceHint: The audience the service expects in its tokens.
connections.forwardUserToken: Forward the user's token unchanged instead of exchanging it
connections.forwardUserTokenWarning: The service receives the user's token and could use it against the AAS server too. Studio forwards it only if it is issued for this audience.

connections.timeoutInvalid: Use a whole number from 1 to 120.
